description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProductViewed' for managing product view statistics in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for installing/uninstalling the associated database table, adding report data, retrieving viewed products, and clearing the data.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: A model class managing the product viewed statistics, including database setup and report functions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the product_viewed table in the database if it does not exist, setting up columns for product_id and viewed count.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the product_viewed table from the database.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts or updates the viewed count for a specific product in the table.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products ordered by viewed count, supports pagination with start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of viewed records.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of all viewed counts across products.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the product_viewed table, clearing all data.
